text: **Hint 1:** Consider how adding a new feature, especially one that is a transformation of an existing feature, might affect the model's ability to generalize to new data. Think about the potential for overfitting.\n\n**Hint 2:** Reflect on the bias-variance tradeoff. Adding a new feature can increase the model's complexity, which might reduce bias but increase variance. How could these changes impact the MSE on held-out test data?
